entities.summary:
Robin Reid is a British former professional boxer who competed from 1993 to 2012. He held the WBC super-middleweight title from 1996 to 1997, and the IBO super-middleweight title from 2004 to 2005. As an amateur, Reid 
represented Great Britain at 1992 Summer Olympics, winning a bronze medal in the light-middleweight division.
